newsitem.title: USA: PECO 1,100 MW Peach Bottom nuke back on line.
newsitem.headline: PECO 1,100 MW Peach Bottom nuke back on line.

text.p: PECO Energy Co's Peach Bottom 2 nuclear power unit, in Delta, Pa., returned to the electricity grid earlier this afternoon, the company said Friday.
"We were back on the grid at 1238 (EDT) today. We should be back to full power by Monday morning," said company spokesman Bill Jones.
The unit was taken off line early Wednesday due to a problem with the oil line to the generator.

Friday spot prices in the Pennsylvania-New Jersey-Maryland (PJM) Interconnect pool for next-day firm electricity during peak periods hovered around the $19.00 per megawatt hour area, down from the $21.00-23.00 area seen on Thursday.
